record.scope: ZUBAT (1 star), GOLBAT (2 stars) and CROBAT (3 stars), the queued units; maxPP 100, range 2 for all three.
record.summary: Single-target SPECIAL damage (20 / 40 / 80 / 160 requested by caster stars: 20 Zubat, 40 Golbat, 80 Crobat), then the caster heals itself for the takenDamage that handleSpecialDamage reports for that hit. The heal is lifesteal on the damage actually taken (shield damage included, residual damage capped at the target's remaining hp), not on the requested amount. The heal is passed apBoost 0 and crit false, so neither AP nor the cast's crit scale it; a blocked hit (protect / skydiving / magicBounce) reports takenDamage 0 and heals nothing. The heal then goes through handleHeal: no healing while the caster is wounded or protected, x1.3 BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED, x0.5 burn, x0.5 enraged, x1.2 ZENITH weather, rounded and capped at the caster's missing hp.

targeting.who: the single current target (damage); the caster itself (heal)

geometry.shape: single target, no area, no movement; range 2 for all listed units

effects.scaling: requested amount: handleSpecialDamage default apBoost = true, so damage x (1 + AP/100); then x2 DOUBLE_DAMAGE (effect consumed) and x1.2 strange-steam board effect where present; crit multiplier only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT because canCritByDefault is false), reduced by target Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite for non-TRUE hits
effects.resolution: applied amount: the target's speDef division damage / (1 + 0.05 x speDef) (speDef halved, rounded, under armorReduction; swapped with def under WONDER_ROOM), flat reductions (Poke Doll x0.7, Guts/Sturdy/Defiant/Coaching, Wonder Guard), ceil with a minimum of 1; the shield absorbs first. takenDamage = shield damage + min(residual, remaining hp); blocked entirely by protect / skydiving / magicBounce (takenDamage 0). Power Lens on the target reflects part of the blocked damage back as SPECIAL damage

effects.condition: always after the damage call; the amount is 0 if takenDamage is 0

starBehavior.note: indexed by the caster's stars (stars-1): 20, 40, 80, 160, fallback 160; the 4-star entry and fallback are not reached by the listed units. The heal has no star table.

record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes; each cast is independent and the heal size follows that cast's takenDamage.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested damage 20 (Zubat) / 40 (Golbat) / 80 (Crobat). Applied damage = requested x (1 + AP/100) [x2 DOUBLE_DAMAGE] [x1.2 strange steam] [x crit factor], then the speDef division (ceil, minimum 1). takenDamage (what the heal uses) = shield damage + residual capped at the target's remaining hp, so the heal can be smaller than the applied damage when the target dies or is nearly dead. Heal requested = takenDamage; received heal = after handleHeal modifiers, rounding and the missing-hp cap.
